title: Enhancing Automated Defect Detection in High-Throughput SEM: Balancing Throughput, Resolution, and Accuracy in Large-Area Analysis
content: High-throughput scanning electron microscopy (SEM) plays a crucial role in accelerating large-area microstructural analysis, particularly in applications requiring both speed and precision in defect detection [1]. This is especially critical for additively manufactured (AM) metals, where nanoscale defects—such as pores and cracks—can significantly impact material performance [2]. However, achieving high-resolution imaging over centimeter-scale areas is inherently time-consuming, creating a trade-off between throughput, resolution, and defect detection reliability.
